name: Create a Reply
description: Create a reply to a ticket. [See the documentation](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#reply_ticket).

configurable_props.name: ticketId
configurable_props.label: Ticket ID
configurable_props.description: Select a ticket or provide a ticket ID

configurable_props.name: body
configurable_props.label: Body
configurable_props.description: Content of the note in HTML format.

configurable_props.name: attachments
configurable_props.label: Attachments
configurable_props.description: The total size of all the ticket's attachments (not just this note) cannot exceed 20MB.

configurable_props.name: fromEmail
configurable_props.label: From Email
configurable_props.description: The email address from which the reply is sent. By default the global support email will be used.

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the agent who is adding the note.

configurable_props.name: ccEmails
configurable_props.label: CC Emails
configurable_props.description: Email address added in the 'cc' field of the outgoing ticket email.

configurable_props.name: bccEmails
configurable_props.label: BCC Emails
configurable_props.description: Email address added in the 'bcc' field of the outgoing ticket email.
